# Rahul Pahuja (full profile)

> Staff / Principal Mobile Systems Architect: enterprise mobile security, hardware-backed cryptography, multi-million dollar scale. Architect of TeeSDK at Idira by Palo Alto Networks (formerly CyberArk). 11+ years across Palo Alto Networks, Bankwest, Conviva, Chevron and Mahindra First Choice Wheels.

Rahul Pahuja is a mobile systems architect based in Indore, India, actively evaluating Staff / Principal Mobile Systems Architect roles (Bangalore, Hyderabad, or Remote) and open for immediate engagement. He was most recently Staff Software Engineer - Mobile Architecture at Idira by Palo Alto Networks (formerly CyberArk) (Nov 2024 – Dec 2025), where he architected TeeSDK, a zero-trust encrypted storage foundation on Android Keystore and iOS Secure Enclave that established the offline baseline to unlock $240M in commercial contract value across 1M+ active enterprise seats. He now runs an independent systems advisory and engineering lab (Mobile1x).

## Now

Since Dec 2025 Rahul is Principal Mobile Systems Architect of an Independent Systems Advisory & Engineering Lab (Mobile1x). Current work: DeDup (privacy-first on-device duplicate media cleaner; Google Play and App Store; 600+ combined active users), Notes: Archive & Reflect (offline-first capture, Android and iOS), The A2Z Collection (production e-commerce architecture sustained at 2,500 DAU) and Smart Form Engine (schema-driven JSON forms, 50% faster form creation). He also maintains AI Similarity, a developer reference that maps Android and iOS APIs side by side.

## Core impact

- $240M+ commercial contract pipeline unlocked by the hardware-backed secure storage and offline baseline at Palo Alto Networks.

## Idira by Palo Alto Networks (formerly CyberArk): architectural decisions

Staff Software Engineer - Mobile Architecture, Nov 2024 – Dec 2025. Apps: iOS https://apps.apple.com/in/app/idira-identity/id499910663; Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.centrify.mdm.samsung&hl=en_IN

- $240M commercial contract impact: architected TeeSDK, a zero-trust encrypted storage foundation on Android Keystore and iOS Secure Enclave, establishing the offline baseline to unlock $240M in commercial contract value across 1M+ active enterprise seats.
- Hardware-enforced biometric defense: engineered cryptographic biometric tampering detection using Keystore CryptoObjects; closed zero-day memory-hooking and runtime Frida bypass vectors across the enterprise mobile attack surface.
- Binary hardening with zero performance penalty: replaced baseline R8/ProGuard with customized DexGuard rulesets (control-flow virtualization, string encryption) and profiled class-loading paths to safeguard cold-start SLA budgets.
- Storage architecture ADR (P50/P95/P99): benchmarked tail latencies comparing Preferences DataStore vs. Proto DataStore; authored the company-wide ADR standardizing Preferences DataStore to eliminate Protobuf serialization overhead while guaranteeing atomic, non-blocking asynchronous I/O.
- 28% latency reduction: optimized TeeSDK cryptographic and I/O execution paths using multi-layer caching with DataStore, cutting cold-start initialization latency by 28%.
- C4 architecture modeling: modeled system topologies across Context, Container, Component, and Code levels, driving STRIDE threat modeling and SSDLC compliance across mobile, backend, and security teams.
